tagline: Learn English Grammar & Vocabulary from Zero (Zero-se-Hero)
mission: Empowering Hindi-medium students from states like Bihar and Uttar Pradesh to master English Grammar and Vocabulary through simple Hinglish explanations, phonetic Devanagari pronunciations, and custom study plans.

personas.name: School Student (Primary)
personas.demographics: Hindi-medium backgrounds, primarily residing in Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Chhattisgarh.
personas.goals: Understand grammar fundamentals from scratch, complete homework, pass school exams.

personas.name: Board Exam Student (Secondary)
personas.goals: Score high marks in Board exams, master NCERT chapter summaries and textbook-based questions.
personas.needs: Bilingual chapter summaries, important questions, exam prep, and specific NCERT-aligned grammar exercises.

personas.name: Competitive Exam Aspirant
personas.goals: Crack the English grammar and vocabulary sections of competitive exams.
personas.needs: Advanced grammar rules, error detection, sentence improvement, active-passive voice, direct-indirect narration, high-frequency vocabulary.

pedagogy_usps: Bilingual hinges: Explanations in natural Hindi, with terms and rules in English.
SOV to SVO: Clear transition training from Hindi Subject-Object-Verb syntax to English Subject-Verb-Object syntax.
Devanagari Pronunciation: English pronunciations transliterated in Devanagari script (e.g. 'मैंगो' for /mæŋ.ɡoʊ/) to overcome pronunciation shyness.
Accordion Vocabularies: Contextual word lists hidden behind expandable `<details>` tags.
Common Mistakes Highlights: Proactively warning students about common Hindi-to-English translation errors.

grammar_syllabus.title: Course Overview & What We Teach
Language and Communication (Hindi vs. English basics)
Alphabet, Phonics, and Pronunciation (Silent letters, vowels)
Advanced Pronunciation & Accent Training
Words, Sentences, and Structures (Subject-Verb-Object word order)
Parts of Speech Overview (Noun to Interjection introduction)
Noun System Deep Study (Types, gender, singular/plural rules, spoken drills)
Pronoun System Deep Study (Subjective, Objective, Possessive cases)
Adjective System Deep Study (Degrees of comparison, determiners, quantifiers)
Verb System Deep Study (Transitive/Intransitive, Auxiliary verbs like is/am/are, has/have)
Adverb System Deep Study (Manner, Time, Place, Frequency, position rules)
Preposition System Deep Study (In, on, at, since, for, common mistakes)
Conjunction and Interjection Systems (Coordinating & Subordinating)
Number, Person, and Agreement (Subject-Verb Agreement rules)
Sentence Drills & Spoken Patterns (Affirmative, Negative, Interrogative, WH-questions)
Tense System Foundation (Simple Present, Past, Future)
Tense System Continuous & Perfect (Progressive & Complete actions)
Advanced Tenses & Complex Patterns (Conditional tenses, sequence of tenses)
Active and Passive Voice (Rules and transformation shortcuts)
Direct and Indirect Speech (Narration changes, reporting verbs)
Conditionals & Complex Sentences (Zero, 1st, 2nd, 3rd conditionals)
Real-Life Spoken & Translation Intelligence (Error correction, speaking drills)
